services.desc: Thousands have been committed to the asylum over the years, and hundreds, unfortunately, died here. Decide for yourself if they’re still occupying the historic wards and treatment rooms.The Asylum has had apparition sightings, unexplainable voices and sounds, and other paranormal activity reported in the past by guests, staff, SyFy’s Ghost Hunters, Ghost Hunters Academy, the Travel Channel’s Ghost Adventures, and Paranormal Challenge. Step back in time and see how the mentally insane lived and died within these walls.Customers obviously under the influence will be asked to leave. services.desc: A tip before you buy tickets: you probably don’t need VIP during our first weekend, especially if you arrive before we open. We keep the line moving, and general admission is usually your best bet on those nights. VIP is most useful on busy nights when the lines get longer. We want you to have a great time without spending extra money on a shorter wait you might not need! Early in the season, especially on opening weekend, crowds are lighter, and the haunted house runs at a slower pace. If you arrive right at 6:00 PM when tickets go on sale, you likely won’t need VIP to get in quickly. As October progresses, demand increases, and VIP tickets become the best option for skipping the wait.

blurb: This National Historic Landmark served as a sanctuary for the mentally ill in the mid-1800s. This 160-year-old asylum holds fascinating stories. It includes Civil War raids and a gold robbery. There are also stories about the “curative” effects of architecture.
